emotion_styles.joy: uplifting composition, open framing, lively movement, warm luminous highlights
emotion_styles.sadness: quiet composition, restrained motion, reflective atmosphere, soft diffused light
emotion_styles.hope: rising perspective, widening horizons, gradual light bloom, forward-moving camera

character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: soft honey-blonde hair in an elegant low chignon, warm rose-brown eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult proportions. They are a florist arranging the first flowers for a sunrise wedding. Their fixed signature outfit is a flowing ivory dress with a pale sage wrap, delicate floral embroidery, and simple heels. Their defining personal object is a tiny bouquet tied with a ribbon from her mother's wedding. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and personal object unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Use this one fixed protagonist identity throughout the theme's entire video.
Preserve the same facial features, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit, silhouette, colors, and defining personal object consistent in every scene.
Do not replace the lead or add another protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in flower-lined ceremony gardens, softly lit celebration halls, sunrise terraces; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with ivory, blush pink, champagne; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide establishing shot with layered depth, slow cinematic dolly-in with stable horizon, gentle lateral tracking shot revealing environmental detail; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
